evidence.s1: Record keeps whole-canvas mean, pre/post-wash footprint mean and declared tone apart for 8 works x 2 schemes; drawn bodies 0.66-0.95 light and 0.13-0.37 dark, 0 lines under floor, and the phase captures agree.
evidence.s2: One named window (the Label) at rest with two ornaments below it (fv light/dark).
evidence.s3: Label window 461 x 720 with thickness 8 recorded for all three surfaces; the span-52 ornament labels are gated by rendered contrast (worst 5.44).
evidence.s4: Viewport-fixed painting canvas visible at the 32 px margins, right of the window and around the ornament row in every phase capture, both schemes.
evidence.s5: Regular only on the window and both ornaments (fv light/dark); record 'no clear'.
evidence.s6: No clear glass anywhere (fv and phase captures).
evidence.s7: No tinted control: navigation and transport are neutral ink on both ornaments (fv light/dark).
evidence.s8: Record's ban subset: no background, border or backdrop-filter on hosts; the window carries the painting's colour through the material in the light phases.
evidence.s9: Window fixed r32, ornaments r26 capsules, inner buttons r22 capsules, data fill r18, whole-work frame r4 (fv, scroller-bottom, forced).
evidence.s10: Data fill inset 14 at r~18 (32-14), whole-work frame inset 28 at r4 and ornament buttons r22 (26-4) read concentric (scroller-bottom dark, shot-forced).
evidence.s11: Floating ornaments are capsules and the one bordered control, the play ring, is circular (fv light, shot-forced).
evidence.s12: The ornament row splits into two groups, room navigation and audio guide, each on its own glass (fv light).
evidence.s13: The rooms ornament puts the '1 / 8' text button (it opens the Rooms view) on one glass with the prev/next chevron icon buttons (fv light; each separately bordered in shot-forced).
evidence.s14: Glass is on the window and ornament housings with plain buttons on them, never on inner views (fv dark).
evidence.s15: Two same-material ornament capsules sit 24 px apart by the derived spacing, reading as deliberately separate groups under the window (fv light/dark).
evidence.s16: The Label window's child scroller carries the whole label with fades at its inner top and bottom while the host and ornament row stay fixed (scroller-1 middle/bottom, light and dark).
evidence.s17: Window and ornaments sit over structured paint in all eight works; even fog's ornaments over Monet's water read with rim and body (phase-8 light/dark).
evidence.s18: Record: 0 readings under floor across phases, schemes, poses and tiers, worst 4.93 on the dark rooms-view row; essay and data lines read cleanly in every phase capture, both schemes.
evidence.s19: unread: shot-reduced shows Reduce Transparency working and the record covers Reduce Motion, but Increase Contrast was neither captured nor recorded.
evidence.s20: Record paints a footprint-shaped wash into the canvas under each regular host, up to 0.82 toward deep neutral in dark; the dark captures show the window as a smoked slab, dimming beneath non-clear, non-modal glass.
evidence.s21: No menu or sheet; nothing morphs or cross-fades on glass, no opacity transition and runtime press only, per record since motion is not in stills.
evidence.s22: Ornament icons and labels are monochrome; colour lives only in the painting and the whole-work image (fv light/dark).
evidence.s23: Ornament labels are dark on light and light on dark bodies, distinct from the paint behind in all phase captures.
evidence.s24: Every reading line on primary ink at weight 500 or more (display italic now 700), label text worst p10 6.34; tertiary only on rules and the ring track (record, fv light/dark).
evidence.s25: Data section on a darker child fill for separation, selected room row on a lifted fill per record, no nested hosts (scroller-bottom light/dark).
evidence.s26: Rooms and guide ornaments are overlay groups hung 64 px below the window by the derived padding, together spanning exactly its 461 px, plain buttons, no overlap (fv light).
evidence.s27: The whole-work image sits in an opaque r4 frame at the 28 px inset (32-28) in every phase; there is no glance module.
evidence.s28: No colour accent; emphasis is size, weight and case (fv light).
evidence.s29: Window and ornaments untinted; identity carried by the eight paintings (phases 1-8).
evidence.s30: Record: cssBody two-layer at DPR 1 (0.355 M px) and collapsed at DPR 2 (1.42 M), both inspected; css-fv reads; shot-forced's Canvas panel keeps text, the whole-work outline and bordered buttons; span-461 extrapolation and 'not visionOS glass' stated.
